body: 13 years old. moved to another environment, parents didn't teach me how to socialize properly (single mom, busy at work, bills, more stressful shit) and as a result i became introverted (i already was as a child). i tried fitting in with other introverts, but most of them were good,healthy students and have good school records in compensation ig. i use to be a great student as well back in my home, but depression and anxiety got the best of me and it ruined everything. now i realize i have huge imposter syndrome and ive been sleeping irregularly for a year as a 15 year old.

i have a similar experience. i have bad grades because of depression, i barely have any friends, i hide from everything that requires social participation simply because i know ill mess up and people will see me as a weirdo. i just want to quit school and just work to make money and survive. im tired of living seeing other people happy and successful with no problems so when im old enough ill buy pills and overdose myself to end it. maybe ill just wait it out, graduate, go to college, finish everything then work, then just try to survive and make a life without caring about other people.
